meta.title: Students' Voice & Student Rep Elections
meta.note: Content sourced from the Year 2 / L3 variant of this deck (see SOURCE_OF_TRUTH note in the PowerPoint's teacher appendix). Swap when a true Year 1 deck is provided.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Students' Voice?
options: Giving students influence over college improvements
questions.explanation: Giving students influence over college improvements

questions.prompt: Which are conditions for student voice actually working, according to the deck? Select all that apply.
options: Reps who actually consult their group - not just improvise at meetings
Groups who tell their rep what matters before the meeting, not after
Students who follow up after the meeting
questions.explanation: All four are the conditions for student voice to actually work.

questions.prompt: How many reps are elected from each group?
Which best describes the Governor role, compared with the Rep role?
options: Strategic scope and institutional weight, not group representation
Same as the Rep role but with more meetings
questions.explanation: The Governor role is different from Student Rep: strategic scope and institutional weight.

questions.prompt: Which skill is developed by being a Student Rep?
What does a Student Governor focus on?
By when must Student Rep elections be completed and the rep confirmed?
questions.explanation: Student Rep elections must be completed and the rep confirmed no later than the end of Week 2.
